messages:
maya: heads-up — reproducible parity bug when using the batching helper + auth refresh on embeddings+rerank sample app. one returned vector is short (1535) vs expected 1536.

maya: quick repro: batch 3 inputs -> helper pads to 4, force token expiry so client refreshes and retries. occasionally the reassembled output contains a truncated vector.

maya: node snippet:
```js
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-1536', input: ['x','y','z'] }); // helper pads to 4
```

maya: observed payload: data array length 4 but last embedding has 1535 floats. no 4xx except initial 401 during refresh.

derek: sounds like mutable pad metadata is being changed between enqueue and retry. are we snapshotting pad flags when we push to the send queue?

ana: in python/sampleapp we snapshot, so python didn't hit it in my run. node helper was mutating in place.

sam: besides fixing snapshotting, two pragmatic steps: 1) have SDK validate embedding length against model profile and throw EmbeddingShapeError with request_id; 2) runtime should include top-level embedding_dim (and echo request_id) so clients can verify without guessing.

maya: filed DE-5033 with logs + minimal repro script. devex-bot created issue.

devex-bot: created issue DE-5033: "batch helper: pad metadata lost on auth-retry causing short embedding" and attached repro.

derek: i'll PR a small change to node helper to deep-clone batch metadata at enqueue and add length checks in assembly. will also add an integration test that expires token mid-send.

ana: i'll add CI matrix: node/python x batchsize 2..8 x pad location head/mid/tail x token-expiry-at-byte to exercise retries.

sam: follow-up: we should also ensure rerank mapping uses per-item source_index (server-side) so score->embedding mapping is robust if ordering changes. cc @eng-runtime.

maya: thanks — will validate canary and close DE-5033 once green. :thumbsup:
